Oceans on The Earth
There are four oceans In order of their size they are Pacific Ocean;
Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean and Arctic Ocean:
Pacific Ocean
The explorer Ferdinand Magellan; who circumnavigated the Earth;
named the ocean 'Pacific" meaning calm Or peaceful:
The Pacific Ocean (Area 166,240,000 sq. km.) is the largest ocean of the
world
It is the deepest ocean with an average depth of 4,200 m.
The Mariana Trench is the world' s deepest trench with a depth 0f 11,033
metres (36,201 feet):
Most of the islands of this ocean are of volcanic or coral origin:

in the world
Its name is derived from Atlas, Titan (giant) in Greek mythology
The Atlantic Ocean has the longest coastline.
The Atlantic Ocean is the busiest ocean for trade and commerce since
its shipping routes connect the two most industrialized regions, namely
